critical_code_review_comments: saas.py DEFAULT_LOYALTY_TIERS provides clean defaults Silver/Gold/Platinum at 10M/15M/30M as documented — verified server preserves order on PUT.

Treatment lookup in bookings.public_availability (line ~237) uses treatment NAME (not id) as query param. Public booking pages must pass the treatment.name to this endpoint — note in any API docs/clients.

Glow Clinic actually has 3 doctors and 3 therapists in DB (not 1+1 as per main-agent note). Test had to restrict all doctors' hours to prove the doctor-only treatment availability constraint — this is environment-state info for future testing agents.

Doctor schedule restriction logic correctly removes slots outside working_hours and respects days_off — verified at slot-level (Mon last available slot = 12:30 when close=13:00, Sat shows zero available, days_off Mon shows zero available).
Therapist availability is correctly unaffected when only doctor schedule is restricted (multi-performer logic working as intended).
